title: What if you could turn off your algorithm? Australia is about to try
summary: New legislation is being tabled in Australia's parliament today to force big tech to allow users to switch off algorithms which send them recommended content.

blocks.text: New legislation is being tabled in Australia's parliament today to force big tech to allow users to switch off algorithms which send them recommended content - but it's not the first country to try.
The BBC's Tiffanie Turnbull in Sydney explains what is being proposed.
